data.content:
further canvas-theme-editor scaffold refinements (preview: http://localhost:5174/tools/canvas-rce, http://localhost:5174/guide/canvas-rce)
* in guide and tool mode, when the popup is active the smartphone/tablet/monitor icon buttons are an off-white color on a white background in light mode.  They appear correctly when the preview pane is in the guide.
* in guide and tool mode, when the popup is active, the preview pane placeholder can be collapsed, we don't need to maintain a large blank space where it will be re-inserted.
* in guide and tool mode when the popup is active the column/row utility switcher button should be disabled.
* in tool mode when the interface theme (not the preview theme in the tray) is in light mode, only the page background changes colors, text and buttons and other interface elements stay in dark mode leaving light-on-light
* in tool mode the tray and its contents always stay in dark mode, regardless of interface theme settings.
* in web app and tools mode if there's no local storage yet, the app displays in row mode by default instead of column mode- and the layout toggle shows 'rows' so clicking it once does nothing, then clicking the 'columns' button switches it to columns.
* in webapp mode the dock icon on a mac is dark on dark, we we should the icon-reversed version on the dark background
